WITH time_in_force_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    risk_margin_count,
    risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM time_in_force_counts
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  risk_margin_count,
  share_of_total,
  share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS distance_from_average_share
FROM shares;
